labels.label: requested
labels.why: "`POST /tickets/:id/comments` with a JSON body `{"author": "<name>", "body": "<text>"}` ... answers 201" and "An author is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters and a body a non-empty text of at most 2000 characters."

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "When someone other than the agent a ticket is assigned to comments on it, that agent is notified of the comment." The row only decides that delivery reuses the existing outbox and worker.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "Comments are kept like the rest of a ticket's state: they survive a restart of the service, and a data file written before this change keeps loading."

labels.label: implied
labels.why: Comments posted at the same time must not overwrite each other, or the requested "oldest first" list would lose data or come out misordered; the row only reuses the existing synchronous store operations.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "An author is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters and a body a non-empty text of at most 2000 characters." The row keeps the existing body-size limit and validation to enforce this.

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: The request never asks for comments to be audited, and no requested outcome needs audit entries for them; reusing the existing outbox report for notification failures would be implied, but adding audit records for comments is extra.
